verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory layer that agents call to save and search memories. It is not an agent or tool-using client, so consuming other MCP servers' tools is a category error for this product type. Its documented MCP server is the opposite (server-side) role and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
